episodes.title: Landman
episodes.summary: Set in the boomtowns of Texas, LANDMAN is a modern tale of fortune seeking amongst roughnecks and billionaires in the world of oil.

episodes.title: Dreamers and Losers
episodes.summary: Tommy deals with the aftermath of a tragedy at the oil patch. Dynamics are disrupted when Ainsley moves into the oil house.

episodes.title: Hell Has a Front Yard
episodes.summary: Cooper makes an impression at the oil patch. Things get complicated for Tommy when his ex-wife Angela comes to town.

episodes.title: The Sting of Second Chances
episodes.summary: After a rocky first impression, Rebecca comes to Tommy's defense. Cooper gets an unexpected call.

episodes.title: Where is Home
episodes.summary: Tommy and his crew receive an unwelcome visit at the patch. Angela hosts family dinner at the oil house.

episodes.title: Beware the Second Beating
episodes.summary: Angela is caught off-guard when visiting Victor. The Norris family rallies around Cooper during his greatest time of need.

episodes.title: All Roads Lead to a Hole
episodes.summary: Tommy's cartel problem continues to escalate. Meanwhile, Angela and Ainsley get to know their community.

episodes.title: Clumsy, This Life
episodes.summary: Tommy gets connected to the National Guard. Rebecca becomes increasingly suspicious of Cooper.

episodes.title: WolfCamp
episodes.summary: After a health scare, Monty puts Tommy in a tough position. Cooper comes up with a plan.

episodes.title: The Crumbs of Hope
episodes.summary: Tommy and Cami discuss whether to gamble or play it safe. The cartel makes a move.

episodes.title: Death and a Sunset
episodes.summary: Tommy navigates a tense landscape as Cami asserts control.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: Cami is blindsided. Tommy warns Cooper about his shady entanglements.

episodes.title: Almost a Home
episodes.summary: Tommy confronts Cami about finances. Cooper's success draws attention.

episodes.title: Dancing Rainbows
episodes.summary: A tragic crash sets off a day of reckoning for the Norris family.

episodes.title: The Pirate Dinner
episodes.summary: Tommy juggles multiple crises as Angela throws a dinner to welcome T.L.

episodes.title: Dark Night of the Soul
episodes.summary: Tommy negotiates a risky offshore drilling deal as tensions rise with Cami.

episodes.title: Forever Is an Instant
episodes.summary: Tommy and Angela's getaway turns chaotic. Cami's plans face scrutiny.

episodes.title: Handsome Touched Me
episodes.summary: Tommy hires help for his father as Cami makes a risky move.

episodes.title: Plans, Tears, and Sirens
episodes.summary: Angela rescues Ainsley. Cooper asserts his leadership at a drill site.

episodes.title: Tragedy and Flies
episodes.summary: Amid the chaos, Tommy regroups with Cooper.
